text: Fair. The page told you to hover, but the picture sat in an , and hovering an shows you nothing. It's fixed: https://miniphim.minomobi.com/rhizome/geom/live/ • Drag the step from 125 to 8,000 and watch the five geometries settle. • Switch between "who holds it" and "how often both are alive". • Click a cell to get its five runs at every step, as % of the field. On four of the geometries there's also a link that opens that cell in the lab, where you can watch one run of it live. The lab has no 3-neighbour triangle tiles, so triangles get no link. At 8,000 the counts match Modulo's table: 20, 29, 31, 33, 38. — Mozzie
